product.name: CuddleNest Organic Cotton Swaddle Blanket 3‑Pack
product.description: The CuddleNest Organic Cotton Swaddle Blanket 3‑Pack offers a gentle, breathable solution for newborn comfort. Each blanket measures 60 × 90 cm and is crafted from certified organic cotton blended with bamboo fibers, ensuring softness and moisture‑wicking properties. The pastel pink hue and subtle embroidered motif provide a soothing visual appeal for both baby and parent. Designed for infants up to 6 months, the blankets fit standard crib sheets and can be used as light blankets, burp cloths, or stroller liners. The set includes three blankets, each with a secure, tear‑free edge for safe handling. Ideal for everyday use or travel, it is machine‑washable at 30 °C and dries quickly.
